name: Muriel
source:
[spoiler]"A fan of archery, she aims to woo and marry an archery competition champion."[/spoiler]

Muriel is a fan of archery, and those who compete in archery events.

[spoiler]She is a drifter who attends archery competitions around the continent. Muriel is giggly, and clearly turned on by those who do well in archery competitions.[/spoiler]
